records.decision_reason: LaLiga's official November 23 statement confirms unauthorized access and exfiltration; affected count remains under investigation.

severity_evidence.reason: LaLiga confirms stolen personal data affecting its users and some clubs; total victim count and financial harm not established.

records.title: LaLiga fan-services platform breached and personal data stolen
records.victim: LaLiga and affiliated clubs' fan-service users
records.what: LaLiga confirmed unauthorized access to a fan-services platform between November 14 and 16, with extraction of registered users' personal data. LaLiga contained the intrusion November 16 and notified Spanish authorities.
records.significance: Confirmed theft of personal data from LaLiga and some affiliated clubs; affected-user count and complete data scope not yet known.
